question_2_brand_association_provenance.brand_association_logic: CHOICE_B (Conversation containing an AmazonHelp reply somewhere in the connected thread graph)
question_2_brand_association_provenance.filtering_condition: has_amazon = any(tweet_author.get(t) == 'AmazonHelp' for t in thread_tids)
question_2_brand_association_provenance.flaw_description: Collects all connected tweets in a tree graph component. If AmazonHelp appears anywhere in the thread, has_amazon is True for the entire graph component. customer_initial_query is assigned to the root tweet of the entire thread component. If root tweet was addressed to @AppleSupport or @hulu_support, it is incorrectly attributed to AmazonHelp.
